title: silent wall clock
text: silent wall clock. It is a large, approx 12" across and silent running clock.  The face is white... the hands are decorative hands (including a sweep second hand) and numbers are black - so while it doesn't glow or light in the dark... I can see it in the dark with a minimum of ambient light.  The outer frame is plastic (?) but sort of looks like wood.  I am very happy with my purchase, however, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Bekith 12 inch Retro Clock Non Ticking Silent Quality Quartz Decorative Home/Office/School Wall Clock
features: Elegant wooden-looking large 12 inch round retro wall clock,
Plastic Case And Lens, makes it easy to clean and keeps dust away from dial.

Stylish retro wall clock. Perfect clock for dining rooms, living rooms, family rooms, bedrooms, study room, kitchen, office, or conference room
